questions.question: What are you learning this for?
questions.why: decides what the app calls progress

questions.question: How long would you like one sitting to be?
questions.why: sizes a lesson to a sitting you actually have

questions.question: How many days a week can you study?
questions.why: sets the review schedule

questions.question: When do you usually study?
questions.why: times reminders, and never sends them at the wrong hour

questions.question: What keeps you going?
questions.why: picks what the progress screen shows first

questions.question: What makes you stop?
questions.why: tells the app what to notice and work around

questions.question: How do you want to hear that you got something wrong?
questions.why: sets the tone of every correction

questions.question: Would you rather start with something hard, or something you can do?
questions.why: sets the opening difficulty of a lesson

questions.question: What do you do when you are stuck?
questions.why: compared later with what you actually did in the locked box

questions.question: Where and on what do you study?
questions.why: decides how light the pages are and whether things must work offline

questions.question: Which language should explanations be in?
questions.why: the language of every explanation

questions.question: Do you like seeing a timer, or does it stress you?
questions.why: shows or hides the clock; the app still measures quietly either way

questions.question: Anything else about how you learn? (one line, optional)
questions.why: read by you later, and shown next to your settings
